description: Agent tools of the BuildY page builder: one definition per tool (name, description, JSON Schema parameters) and the chat modes that offer it. Hosts (chat runtime, WordPress builder) send only the tools of the active mode. x-buildy-enum names a value list the host fills from its pinned catalog or page contract before sending; hosts strip every x-* keyword. See ADR-0011.

ask.description: Conversation about the catalog and the page. Read-only: Ask has no write tool and never changes the page or creates a proposal; changes are made in Build. Tool choice auto; the model's final text is the answer.

build.description: Edit the page. Tool choice required: read with tools, then write_page. An accepted write ends the turn and creates a pending proposal (a diff) for Apply. A text-only response creates no proposal; the host may nudge once.

enumSources.catalog.items: Every block of the catalog (registry item names)

tools.name: list_blocks
tools.description: List every block of the catalog (it is small): item, title, category, description, default variant and every variant with its label. Read-only.

tools.name: get_block
tools.description: Read one block of the catalog: its variants (label, layout axes, default settings such as align), the props you write (names, kinds, enums, rows; ? = optional) and the sample props a new block starts with. Read-only.

item.description: Registry item name of the block.

variant.description: Variant whose sample props to show; default variant when omitted.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read the page document as it is now in this turn: { version, slug, title, locale, seo, blocks:[{ id, item, variant, props }] }. props are exactly the component props. When a block throws or shows nothing in the preview, renderProblems lists it with the path of the prop to fix. Read-only.

tools.name: write_page
tools.description: Write the page: send the whole page document ({ page }) or an RFC 6902 JSON Patch of it ({ patch }). The host checks it and returns the diff or [{ path, code, expected, got }].

page.description: The whole page document: { title, slug, locale, seo: { title, description }, blocks: [{ id?, item, variant?, props }] }. A block without id gets one; a new block starts from the registry sample props, then your props. locale is the ISO code of the language the author writes in.

patch.description: RFC 6902 operations on the page document (add, replace, remove, move, copy, test), paths as JSON Pointers: /title, /locale, /seo/description, /blocks/2/props/title, /blocks/- (append).
